topic: Packing independent rows in the 96-dispatch Q4 decode GEMV chain to reduce intra-submission gaps
question: Can any same-input (independent-row) Q4 decode GEMV dispatches still be packed into fewer dispatches, repeatably and bit-correctly, to cut the intra-submission gap bucket (7.25-8.09 ms/token on current main)?
source_note: Worktree main-release HEAD; contains GitHub main 12bf647c plus receipt-only commits. No shared-main mutation; receipt branch wave/Q4RowPackingNegative only.

structural_findings.mechanism_on_main: EagerFusionScope (overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/fused_chain.cpp:727-827) plans decode GEMV groups: affine transposed 4-bit/group-64 QuantizedMatmul nodes sharing one single-row x form groups of up to kQmmVecMultiWeights=3 (compute.h:36) in tape order, dispatched as ONE QmmVecQ4MultiSubgroupF16; a single-member group is planned only when it carries an Add epilogue (fused_chain.cpp:813), which folds the residual add into the GEMV store.
structural_findings.live_census_94d9d47: receipts/2026-09-10-decode-bound-3 baseline profile: 273 dispatches/token, 2 submissions/token; QmmVecQ4MultiSubgroupF16 = 96 = 24 layers x 4 groups {qkv: q+k+v = 3 members, o: 1 member + residual epilogue, gate/up: 2 members, down: 1 member + residual epilogue}, plus 1 lm-head QmmVecQ4WordSubgroupF16. Layer-1 workgroup counts in the token table (144=qkv 1152 rows, 112=o 896 rows, 1216=gateup 9728 rows, 112=down 896 rows) confirm the membership.
structural_findings.code_identity_since_census: git diff 94d9d47..b6d662a8 -- overlay/ touches only the custom-kernel surface (custom_kernel.cpp added, compute.cpp/h registrations, encoder.cpp/h, CustomKernel::eval_gpu relocation out of primitives.cpp, test_fast_ops.cpp). The quantized GEMV group path, fused_chain.cpp and qmm_vec shaders are byte-identical, so the 94d9d47 dispatch census describes b6d662a8; the fresh digest runs below confirm behavior at b6d662a8.
structural_findings.exhaustion: The four per-layer groups have pairwise distinct inputs chained by non-GEMV dependencies: ln1(x) -> qkv -> (k-rope, KV slice-update pair, q-rope, SDPA) -> o with residual add -> ln2 -> gate/up -> SwiGLU -> down with residual add -> next layer's ln1. No two remaining groups share an x, so no legal packing pair exists anywhere in the chain; raising kQmmVecMultiWeights to 4 would find no fourth same-x member (attention has exactly 3 same-x projections, MLP exactly 2). Within-dispatch packing of independent rows is therefore already maximal on main.
structural_findings.rounding_audit: Every further dispatch-count cut inside the chain requires folding a non-GEMV dependency into a GEMV dispatch: q/k RoPE into the qkv store, ln1/ln2 prologues, or SwiGLU into the down prologue. The landed chain rounds each stage to f16 in memory (RoPE reads stored f16 q/k; the norms read stored f16 residual h; SwiGLU reads stored f16 gate/up), while a folded kernel would consume the GEMV's pre-rounding f32 accumulator or produce pre-rounded f32 into the next stage. Bits differ, so every such candidate fails the exact-six-digest identity gate by construction and was not screened on hardware.

do_not_repeat.idea: 4-accumulator rows sharing one x load inside qmm_vec
packing q/k/v and gate/up into one dispatch each with residual/bias epilogues
do_not_repeat.receipt: receipts/2026-09-09-decode-fusion/verdict.json - ALREADY LANDED on main (+7.7/+4.9/+7.2% Q4 decode)

fresh_paired_evidence.protocol: six legs = fork/stock x {short 30-prompt/32-token, long 262/128, longctx 1053/32}, greedy temp 0 seed 0, EOS suppressed, MLX_DISABLE_COMPILE=1, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, one lock window; plus an unpacked positive-control screen (fork driver, MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_GEMV=0, short workload).

unpacked_screen.what: MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_GEMV=0 disables the same-x group planner: q/k/v and gate/up go back to one dispatch each (+72 dispatches/token predicted at 24 layers), o/down keep their solo epilogue dispatches.
unpacked_screen.result: decode 112.78 -> 102.41 tok/s at 30 tokens (-9.19%), digest unchanged (7fd25a869ff21678). Per-row arithmetic is identical, so identity holds; the tok/s drop at ~40 us wall per one-workgroup dispatch is consistent with the re-inflated dispatch count.
unpacked_screen.reading: Positive control: the landed independent-row packing is live at b6d662a8 and is worth ~9% of short decode; unpacking is the only direction that changes dispatch count while preserving digests, and it is a regression.

decision_note: No source change lands. The 96-dispatch chain's independent rows are already maximally packed on main (landed DecodeFusion); the remaining groups are separated by data dependencies, and every conceivable further fold breaks f16 rounding and the exact six digests. Gated barriers remain rejected and were not re-screened.

next.lever: Dispatch-count reductions beyond this point need either a wider cross-eager-scope planner boundary (decode-bound-3 next.lever) or identity-preserving f16-rounding formulations of norm/rope/swiglu folds, which do not exist today.
